articles.title: Top & Bottom Bond Funds 2Q26: Bond Markets Rebound, but Rate Risks Remain
articles.claim_summary: Bond funds staged a broad rebound in 2Q26 as the first-quarter energy shock eased, though interest rate risks remain for the rest of the year.

findings.title: Bond market flashing a warning signal for stocks - CNBC
findings.reason: The article reports that the iShares iBoxx $ High Yield Corporate Bond ETF (HYG) is on track for its third consecutive monthly decline and fifth in the past six months as the U.S.-Iran war drags on. This persistent weakness across the second quarter undercuts the claim that bond funds staged a broad rebound in 2Q26.

articles.title: Bank of Japan Hikes as Expected: What Comes After 1.0%?
articles.claim_summary: BOJ raised its policy rate to 1.0%, reflecting growing confidence in Japan's economic normalisation, with further gradual hikes likely.

findings.title: Bank of Japan to signal more rate hikes as price pressures build - The Edge Malaysia
findings.reason: The article confirms the BOJ hiked rates in June to 1% and indicates the central bank is set to signal scope for further rate hikes, with analysts at Mitsubishi UFJ Morgan Stanley Securities expecting the next increase around December.
